name: Chen Xuan
role: Our hero. A calm, lazy-looking operations supervisor at Hengxin Logistics who leaves at 4:55.

name: Hu Dewei
role: Department Manager at Hengxin Logistics, on the twelfth floor. Carries a huge mug.

name: Pan Xiulan
role: Chatty coworker who praises whoever seems to be winning, then switches sides.

name: Zhang Pengfei
role: Coworker in a pressed suit who works late nights hoping for a promotion.

later.role: Lost the quarterly top score by 0.2 points; asks for a recount.
His signature sits on the port invoice. Lost the recount.

name: Sun Haoran
role: General Manager of Hengxin Logistics. Visits the twelfth floor about twice a year.

name: Liu Meifang
role: Chen Xuan's mother in Yunxi. Loud, worried, and always feeding him pork-rib soup.

name: Chen Mingde
role: Chen Xuan's Second Uncle. Runs a hardware shop on Old Street. Arrested that afternoon.

later.role: Freed by Director Mai, who apologized to him.

name: Wu Lanying
role: Second Aunt, Chen Mingde's wife. Shaken and crying after her husband's arrest.

name: Chen Jianguo
role: Chen Xuan's father. Proud, hot-tempered, and slapped in the street on Old Street.

name: Chen Hao
role: Chen Xuan's brother. Wears an earbud and teases him about sleeping.

name: Chen Yuan
role: Chen Xuan's sister. Teaches junior high and scolds him bluntly.

name: Wang Lei
role: Old classmate who quietly paid for Chen Xuan's meals in senior year. Now drives a tricycle.

name: Cheng Biao
role: Police official at Old Street station. Brother Tie calls him his uncle.

later.role: Second in command of county police, and runs Old Street station. Bullies juniors.
Suspended from every post by Director Mai. Taken away in a car.

name: Yan Tiehu
role: Leads Hongrui's 'security team', a crew of eight who collect debts and break things.

later.role: Arrested in the Special Police raid; cried for his uncle.

name: Niu Dali
role: Hongrui security man with big front teeth. Works for Brother Tie.

later.role: Brought Old Yu a 20,000 yuan envelope and hinted at harm to Ning.

name: Yao Xiaolong
role: Brother Tie's crewman. Thin, and cackles at every joke.

later.role: Swung an iron pipe at Old Yu's sign. Hit by a flying iron shoe last.

name: Meng Xiaofang
role: Bun-stall owner on Old Street. Saw the slap and was too scared to speak.

later.role: Joined the thumbprint pledge and promised to tell what she saw.

name: Yu Changshun
role: Tailor on Old Street who stood frozen while Chen Jianguo was slapped.

later.role: Saw the 2:03 paint-shelf fall. Joined the thumbprint pledge.
Wrote a signed statement on the 2:03 fall and gave it to Chen Xuan.

name: Wei Kun
role: Duty officer at Old Street station, tired, with twelve years on the job.

later.role: Refused Cheng's false time and wrote the true hour, 7:50 a.m.
Named Acting Deputy Chief of Old Street Station.

name: Lei Bo
role: Young officer who laughs one second before Cheng Biao does. Mocks complaints.

later.role: Took a 5,000 yuan envelope from Brother Tie for his silence.
Denied knowing Cheng Biao once Director Mai arrived.

name: Zhou Pingan
role: Nineteen-year-old auxiliary at the station door. Cheng Biao knocked his cap off.

name: Number Forty-two
role: Big night driver at Old Street station. Wants to flatten Chen Xuan's tires.

name: Number Thirty-four
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Secret guard of the hero, posing as the station's records clerk.

later.role: Spilled Lei Bo's tea and saved the poison tube as proof.

name: Number One
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Hidden Black Pine Guard chief. Receives Chen Xuan's text orders by phone.

later.role: Commands the 214 hidden men watching Old Street.

name: Fan Weiguo
role: County Party Secretary and top official in Yunxi. Speaks softly and never shouts.

later.role: Strips Lu of the Old Street project; faces Tao's push for files.

name: Tao Shu
role: County Magistrate who runs the county government. Only the Party Secretary ranks above him.

later.role: Has waited eight years for Fan's chair. Offers to clean up Old Street files.
Secretly asked for a check on Chen Xuan, then ordered silence.

name: Lu Wenzhe
role: Executive Deputy Magistrate. Holds the county's money and takes 'service fees'.

later.role: Removed from the Old Street project. Office records sealed.

name: Dong Haisheng
role: Head of Hongrui Real Estate. Pays officials per signature to clear Old Street.

later.role: Caught with the ledgers. Ordered to stay in Yunxi; passport taken.

name: Gu Min
role: Aide to Executive Deputy Magistrate Lu, who watches the room quietly.

later.role: Secretly passes Lu's words to Dong and hides his notebook from Lu.
Now carries Tao's briefcase and keeps Tao's secrets.

name: Han Guifu
role: Cobbler on Old Street. Joined the thumbprint pledge against Hongrui.

later.role: Threw an iron shoe last at Thin Monkey to defend Old Yu's sign.

name: Kuang Guihua
role: Vegetable seller on Old Street. Once told Chen Mingde to sign, then changed her mind.

name: Number One Hundred and Four
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Attorney from the Black Pine Guard's law firm, sitting at a tea stall with a briefcase.

name: Number Ninety-two
role: Heart specialist who swapped into the night shift at People's Hospital.

name: Number Ninety-five
role: Head nurse at People's Hospital. Keeps Chen Mingde's pill record on her desk.

later.role: Met Su Min by a 'chance' bump at a pharmacy, arranging help for Wei Kun's family.

name: Number Twenty-three
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Secret Black Pine Guard member who runs Gong's Noodles as a watch post on Old Street.

name: Number Sixty-eight
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Works with Number Twenty-three at Gong's Noodles. Shares his secret watch.

name: Huang Boren
role: Soft-voiced lender who charges Dong 2% a month. Threatens him over his loans.

later.role: Promises to send someone to sit with Dong after the ledger raid.

name: Zhong Hai
role: Wei Kun's desk neighbor and tea partner for ten years.

later.role: Sold Wei Kun's true hour to Lei Bo for a 60,000 yuan loan.

name: Su Min
role: Wei Kun's pregnant wife. Asks him every night if he had a good day.

later.role: Nurse Qiao 'bumped into' her. Family gets a spring-ward bed and a free flat.

name: Yu Ning
role: Nine-year-old granddaughter of Old Yu. Does homework at his shop on Saturdays.

later.role: Scraped her palm in the truck crash, then saw her grandfather's sign smashed.

name: Zhong Tiantian
role: Six-year-old son of Zhong Hai. Needs a heart operation the family cannot pay for.

later.role: Has a fourth-floor hospital bed; surgery paid by a fake charity fund.

name: Number Seven
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Captain of the hidden van team, based in a flower-delivery van.

name: Number Nineteen
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Deputy in Captain Tang's hidden van team. Passes on Number One's orders.

name: Number Seventy-three
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Round baker. His bread truck crashes a hired van at the river arch.

name: Number Fifty-six
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Delivery rider who sat beside Chen Xuan in the lobby, then reported to Number Twenty-three.

name: Bao Zhen
role: City Special Police team leader. Salutes the Black Pine badge without being told.

name: Xie Boyuan
role: Bookkeeper in Brother Tie's crew who escaped the raid on foot.

later.role: Caught holding the debt book; blames Dong for the fire plan.

name: Qian Yu
role: Night clerk at the Municipal Discipline Commission. Took Bai's nineteen-page complaint.

name: Number Eleven
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Number Eleven, the Black Pine Guard's lawyer, with silver-rimmed glasses.

name: Mai Zhenhua
role: Yunxi Police Director and Deputy County Magistrate. Suspends Cheng Biao at dawn.

later.role: Ordered to bring the original detention notice to the inspectors.

name: Chen Xiaoqing
role: Chen Mingde's daughter, a student in Wuhan. Her graduation is coming up.

name: Chen Fugen
role: Chen Xuan's grandfather, age 78. Loud, proud, and fishes at a reservoir.

name: Zhao Dehai
role: Retired Governor of Lanshui. Village thinks he was only a clerk.

name: Ren Gang
role: Colonel who guards Old Zhao with forty men. Sells cabbages as a cover.

name: Gao Zhengyi
role: Provincial Vice Director. Jumps to attention when Retired Governor Zhao calls.

later.role: Leads the provincial inspection team in Yunxi. Refuses gifts and cancels the banquet.

name: Number Nine
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Hidden guard codenamed Number Nine. Carries the Black Pine badge that commands elite teams.

name: Kang Guangming
role: Gray Discipline Commission man who can investigate anyone, even the Secretary.

name: Shao Wenhua
role: Organization Department head who decides promotions and rarely speaks.

name: Lin Dong
role: Youngest clerk on the twelfth floor. Works out prices on his phone calculator.

name: Ge Qinghe
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Hengxin cleaner. Secretly Number Fourteen of the Inner Ring.

name: Hao Jingshan
role: Tea-stall owner on Binjiang Road. Holds a high rank, sells rare tea for thirty yuan.

name: Pu Jian
role: Provincial Organization Department officer. Tao asked him to check Chen Xuan.

name: Number Eighty-nine
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Baker at the Golden Wheat truck. Sends messages to Number One under his counter.

name: Qi Zihao
role: Wealthy young man with a Silver hotel card. Loud and boastful.

later.role: Lent Zhang his card and car; shouted when the card was refused.

name: Dai Wenbin
role: General Manager of Yunhai Grand Hotel. Has secret orders to serve one guest without questions.

name: Qi Jiancheng
role: Father of Qi Zihao. His son says one call from him can ruin a hotel.

name: Liang Yuhang
role: Young aide of Zhao Dehai. Walked the river bank at dawn and missed the bakery van.

name: Pang Jinquan
role: Gate guard who buys buns from Number Eighty-nine every morning.

name: Ma Baoguo
role: Housing Bureau chief who called Lu Wenzhe 'Elder Brother' over wine and now keeps his distance.

name: The Zero Guard
role: A fully masked, genderless-voiced ghost force solely for Chen Xuan with unrecorded numbers. Nobody except Number One even knows they exist, and only Chen Xuan himself can activate or command them.
